title: When in doubt, throw it out!
description:
When the wrong things go down the toilet, the entire system can clog. 🚽 This can leave residents unable to shower, do dishes, or use the bathroom.

Please do your part and help keep San Diego flowing! When in doubt, throw it out. Check out what shouldn't be flushed: sandiego.gov/public-utilities/customer-support/do-not-flush

#SanDiego #CityOfSanDiego
